title: 2016 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: Jefferson Middle School has the same number of boys and girls. Three-fourths of the girls and two-thirds of the boys went on a field trip. What fraction of the students on the field trip were girls?

solutions.text:
Suppose there are \(12\) girls and \(12\) boys. Then \(9\) girls and \(8\) boys go on the field trip, so the fraction of field-trip students who are girls is \(\dfrac{9}{9+8}=\dfrac9{17}.\)

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Choose a convenient equal number of boys and girls.
Using \(12\) boys and \(12\) girls makes both fractions whole numbers.
